description:
Use this when a travel agent needs US airport status: one-airport briefing (kind="intuitive", the default; pass airport=SFO or omit to default to SFO), delay breakdown and recent history (kind="stats"), a multi-airport or origin/destination delay-risk compare including destination weather (kind="pro"; pass origin and destination or airports=SFO,JFK), or ground stop / GDP / severe-weather flags with a Data BitScore (kind="signals"). Informational only, not a delay prediction, and not for navigation. Example: get_travel_data(kind="intuitive", airport="SFO"). Not endorsed by aviation or weather agencies. get_airport_data is a deprecated alias of this tool. Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when a travel agent needs one airport briefing before a departure or connection. Pass airport (IATA or ICAO, e.g. SFO); omit to default to SFO. Returns delays, closures, current weather and alerts. Not for navigation. Example: GET /api/v1/data/travel_intuitive?airport=SFO or MCP get_travel_data(kind="intuitive"). 10 sats or $0.01 USDC.
- kind="stats": 50 sats or $0.05 USDC. Use this when a travel agent needs the breakdown of why an airport is delayed (cause and FAA program) and how that has changed in recent snapshots. Pass airport (IATA or ICAO); omit to default to SFO. Informational only, not for navigation. Example: GET /api/v1/data/travel_stats?airport=SFO or MCP get_travel_data(kind="stats", airport="SFO").
- kind="pro": 100 sats or $0.10 USDC. Use this when a travel agent is comparing two or more US airports, or an origin and destination, and needs an informational delay-risk estimate that includes destination weather. Pass origin and destination, or airports=SFO,LAX. Informational only, not a prediction of an actual delay, and not for navigation.
- kind="signals": 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Use this when a monitoring or travel agent must know whether a US airport has a ground stop, a ground delay program (GDP), a closure, or a severe-weather flag. Pass airport (IATA or ICAO); omit to default to SFO. Returns flags, supporting events and a Data BitScore. Feedable with the airport_delay trigger. Informational only, not for navigation.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer. Deprecated alias of get_travel_data.

airport.description: US airport IATA (SFO) or ICAO (KSFO) code. Optional; defaults to SFO for intuitive, stats and signals.

airports.description: Comma-separated airports for kind=pro, e.g. SFO,JFK.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description. Defaults to "intuitive".

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
